s.h: Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
s.t:
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora,你好, hallo, vítejte!
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

s.h: What you'd be doing in this role
s.t:
Canva is making experimentation a much bigger part of how we build and ship product.
At our scale, shipping changes and watching what happens isn't enough. Teams need to know whether a change actually improved the product and catch changes that unexpectedly hurt important guardrails such as retention or application performance.
This Staff Software Engineer will provide senior technical leadership across the backend systems behind Canva 's experimentation programme.
You'll help evolve the platform teams use to set up experiments, target users, expose variants and measure outcomes in the safest and most intuitive way possible. We're moving towards a platform that does more than report results. It should reinforce good experimentation practices, surface signals faster and alert early when things go wrong.
With the advent of AI, we’re also looking at how we can automate more of the analysis process to help our teams learn faster and iterate.
You'll take ownership of significant technical problems, work with senior leaders across Canva and help shape where the platform should go next by working with the teams building the platform.
We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Backend platform engineering: You've built backend systems or platforms that other engineers depend on, and understand what changes when your software becomes part of somebody else's critical path.
Experimentation exposure at scale: You've built, operated or worked deeply with experimentation, A/B testing, feature-management or progressive-rollout systems in a large engineering environment.
Technical leadership: You've taken ambiguous engineering problems, formed a technical direction and helped other engineers move towards an outcome.
Driving adoption: You've built internal platforms or capabilities and understand that the technology only succeeds when other teams trust and use it.

Backend and distributed systems: Strong software engineering fundamentals, with experience designing reliable backend systems and reasoning about scalability, availability, consistency and failure modes.
Data systems: Enough familiarity with data engineering, analytics engineering or large-scale data processing to understand how experimentation data is generated, moved and consumed.
Experimentation concepts: Familiarity with experiment assignment, targeting, variants, feature flags, metrics, guardrails and progressive rollout.
Language depth: Java is our primary language and would be useful, but it isn't a hard requirement. At Staff level, we're more interested in strong engineering fundamentals and your ability to transfer them between languages.

You've built this before: Direct experience designing or building experimentation, A/B testing, feature-management or rollout infrastructure — either inside a large technology company or for a platform vendor.
Data crossover: A background spanning software engineering and data science, data engineering or analytics engineering.
Feature flags: Experience building feature flagging, user targeting, progressive rollout or automated guardrail systems.
Statistical intuition: You don't need to be a data scientist, but being comfortable enough with experimentation and statistics to work closely with one will be valuable.

This role sits within Rollout Insights, the subgroup responsible for experimentation at Canva .
The team builds shared experimentation capabilities used across the company.
Engineers use the platform to configure and launch experiments. Data scientists use the resulting data to understand impact. Product teams use those insights to decide what should roll out, change or stop.
The team already brings together software engineering and senior data science expertise, which matters because the hardest problems sit across both disciplines.
You'll also collaborate broadly across Canva 's engineering and data science organisations, including with senior technical leaders who depend on the platform.
Experimentation is now a major company priority, so demand for the team's capabilities is growing quickly. There's already a platform to build from, with plenty of important technical work still ahead.
What's in it for you?
Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva , too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

s.h: Here's a taste of what's on offer
s.t:
Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally
Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.
Other stuff to know
We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva . We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.
We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.
When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva , so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!
Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.
Where and how you can work
Our flagship campus is in Sydney, with a second campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth, & Adelaide. You have flexibility in how and where you work — whether that's from one of our spaces, from home, or a mix of both. This role is remote-friendly within Australia , so you can choose the setup that empowers you and your team to do your best work.

At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face-to-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement.

When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China - your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide.

If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here. We’re hiring 2 x Senior Full Stack Engineer to own the end-to-end development of our next-gen AI products.

Requirements You'll bridge the gap between complex AI capabilities and beautiful user experiences, developing the customer-facing features, high-performance APIs, and reliable backend services that make intelligent, autonomous workflows reality.

What You’ll Do Build Meaningful Experiences: Partner closely with a cross-functional team of designers, product managers, and ML engineers to shape and deliver thoughtful, high-quality AI-powered user experiences.

Bridge Frontend & Backend: Co-create and refine full-stack features, utilizing React/Next.js for intuitive frontends and Python or Node.js to power robust, reliable backend services.

Bring AI to Life: Integrate LLM APIs and innovative agentic frameworks into fluid product features—crafting interactive streaming UIs, clear tool-call results, and helpful agent status displays.

Design Accessible Connections: Cultivate and maintain clean REST and/or GraphQL APIs that seamlessly support user data, smooth session management, and helpful agent interactions.

Champion Quality Together: Write thoughtful unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure product excellence, and engage in constructive, supportive code reviews that help the whole team grow.

Support Team Resilience: Contribute to a shared, collaborative on-call rotation, working as a team to support production systems, document thoughtful learnings, and keep our platform running smoothly.

Shape Our Technical Future: Share your unique perspective in architectural discussions and contribute technical proposals that help our systems scale sustainably. ﻿What you'll bring A Passion for Full-Stack & AI: Deep, hands-on experience building full-stack applications, with a special focus on native AI stack development.

Core Technical Comfort: A strong foundational comfort with TypeScript (React, Next.js) on the front end, paired with Python and SQL on the backend. AI Integration Experience: Experience successfully bringing AI to life in production, specifically by integrating with LLM APIs or crafting intuitive AI-powered features.

Thoughtful System Design: A clear understanding of RESTful API design, database management (such as PostgreSQL or Redis), and cloud ecosystems. An Eye for Real-Time UX: Familiarity with creating smooth, real-time user experiences using streaming responses (like SSE or WebSockets) so our AI feels fluid and responsive.

DevOps Awareness: Comfort collaborating on continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), containerization (Docker), and smooth cloud deployments. Empathetic Communication: Highly developed communication skills and a natural ability to listen, share ideas, and partner effectively within a cross-functional team.

Nice to Have If you have experience in any of these areas, that’s wonderful! If not, we are excited to support your learning on the job: Familiarity with agentic frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph. Exposure to building vector search or RAG-based capabilities.

A background or interest in crafting interactive interfaces like chat, copilots, or workflow automation tools. Benefits At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work.

This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact.

Some of the benefits of working at Serko are: A competitive base pay Medical Benefits Discretionary incentive plan based on individual and company performance Focus on development: Access to a learning & development platform and opportunity for you to own your career pathways Flexible work policy The pay range is between $152,000 - $230,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

A Note on Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide sponsorship or assume sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status). Originally posted on Himalayas

Wir bei meinMPP betreiben eine B2B-Plattform für das Mitarbeiter-PC-Programm – ein Steuervorteil, über den Beschäftigte per Entgeltumwandlung an moderne Hardware kommen. Für die Unternehmen ist das komplett verwaltungsfrei, für uns bedeutet es: eine Plattform, die einfach laufen muss, mit über 2.500 Produkten, sauberer Bestellabwicklung und einer Admin-Oberfläche, die den Betrieb für alle Beteiligten so schlank wie möglich hält.
Wir sind ein kleines, remote-arbeitendes Team und legen Wert auf das modernste System im Markt – gebaut auf europäischer Infrastruktur, mit Datenminimierung als Prinzip statt als Marketing-Floskel. Unser Stack ist Laravel mit Filament im Backend, Meilisearch für die Suche, das Ganze auf Kubernetes. Wir suchen jemanden, der das nicht nur weiterentwickelt, sondern mitgestaltet.
Und noch was: KI ist bei uns fester Bestandteil der Arbeit, kein Fremdkörper. Wir erwarten, dass du Tools wie Copilot, Claude & Co. selbstverständlich nutzt – aber als Verstärker deiner eigenen Denkleistung, nicht als Ersatz dafür. Wer versteht, was er da baut, wird mit KI schneller und besser. Wer sie nur Code rausspucken lässt und hofft, dass es passt, ist bei uns falsch.
Aufgaben
Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Plattform auf Basis von Laravel und Filament – vom Shop-Frontend bis zur Admin-Oberfläche
Du baust und integrierst APIs, über die wir mit Partnern, Distributoren und Benefit-Plattformen zusammenarbeiten
Du sorgst für wartbaren, skalierbaren Code und triffst Architekturentscheidungen, die auch in zwei Jahren noch tragen
Du kümmerst dich um die Suchfunktion (Meilisearch) und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Bestell- und Abwicklungslogik
Du baust Testautomatisierung aus, damit wir schnell und trotzdem zuverlässig ausliefern können
Du setzt KI-Tools als festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeit ein – als Verstärker deiner eigenen Denkleistung, nicht als Ersatz für Verständnis und saubere Entscheidungen
Qualifikation
Mehrere Jahre Praxiserfahrung mit PHP und Laravel. Du kennst das Framework nicht aus dem Tutorial, sondern aus echten Projekten
Eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise. Du treibst Themen eigenständig voran und wartest nicht auf Anweisungen
Erfahrung darin, wartbare und skalierbare Software zu bauen, die auch nach Jahren noch verständlich ist
Sicherheit in der Entwicklung und Integration von APIs
Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung

Remote arbeiten
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Firmenhandy
Mitarbeiter-PC-Programm
Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Last words...
Bewirb dich bitte nur, wenn das Anforderungsporfil mit deiner Erfahrung matched.
Vergiss Zeugnisse, oder Ausbildungen. Zeig uns lieber deine Projekte und Erfahrungen. Gerne auch Beispiel-Repositories anfügen.
Die Abteilung befindet sich im Aufbau, daher suchen wir eher Menschen mit Erfahrung (Senior-Level)
Wir freuen uns wahnsinnig auf deine Bewerbung!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, Workflows, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on end-to-end data analytics and MLOps solutions composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast.

You may also work on ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hours! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.

s.h: What your day will look like
s.t:
Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers
Debug issues and interact in public with upstream and Ubuntu communities
Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
Professional or academic software delivery using Python
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

s.h: Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
s.t:
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

s.h: Additional skills that would be nice to have
s.t:
The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions, data pipelines, or orchestrating workflows for the cloud.
Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Working knowledge of cloud computing
Passionate about software quality and testing
Experience working on an open source project

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme

About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

You’ll guide database design, oversee programming activities, troubleshoot complex technical issues, support system administration, forecast project needs, and contribute to SOP and process development. eleQtron develops full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser-cooled ions, microwave and RF control, engineered magnetic field gradients, and advanced theoretical modelling to build scalable quantum processors. In this role, you will contribute to the development of a next-generation Deep Digital Twin software for trapped-ion quantum computers. You will work at the intersection of quantum technologies, numerical simulation, scientific computing, and software engineering, developing predictive models that connect microscopic physical processes to system-level performance metrics.
A key component of the position is transforming and extending existing research-grade simulation tools into a robust, scalable, and maintainable software framework. These tools will support hardware design, control optimization, system characterization, performance benchmarking, and the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures.
The Deep Digital Twin is envisioned as a multi-scale simulation framework spanning several layers of abstraction, from ion trapping, control fields, and noise processes, through quantum state preparation and laser cooling to gate dynamics and reasout, ultimately interfacing with circuit-level simulators and quantum error correction workflows.
You will collaborate closely with theorists, experimental physicists, software developers, and engineers to ensure consistency between physical models, numerical simulations, and experimental observations.

POS-12938 Senior Software Engineer I, Financial Systems The Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems role sits at the intersection of software engineering and financial systems.

This is a full-time software engineering role with a financial systems specialization -- a technologist who builds and owns the integration layer that keeps HubSpot financially accurate, compliant, and fast.

This role exists to partner with HubSpot 's Finance organization to make sure HubSpot can quickly and accurately understand its financial position, report revenue correctly, serve customers efficiently, and inform business decisions with reliable financial data.

It is a cross-functional role by design, built to work across Finance, Compliance, Security, Internal Audit, and external auditors alongside engineering and product teams. Engineers in this role own the integration layer across HubSpot 's financial systems: Aptitude, NetSuite, SOVOS, Avalara, and similar platforms.

The ongoing work is integration ownership, compliance, and incremental improvements to our reporting pipelines, revenue recognition systems, and general ledgers. The right candidate is a strong software engineer who finds financial systems compelling -- someone drawn to building at the intersection of technical rigor and financial correctness.

KEY EXPECTATIONS A Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems is a technologist. They can run with complex financial systems projects autonomously, design sound integrations, and deliver solutions that are both technically correct and financially rigorous.
Can iron out the vagaries of requirements, break problems down into tractable pieces, and implement each piece with minimal hand-holding.
Takes initiative and demonstrates ownership by driving quality improvements, resolving incidents, and following through on commitments to deliver reliable results.
Builds with financial rigor. Understands that a bug in a billing feature is a bad customer experience, but a bug in revenue recognition is a restatement. Financial correctness is a quality bar, not an afterthought.
Understands complex financial domains at a working level: revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15), SOX compliance requirements (change management, segregation of duties, audit evidence, second reviewer), and how data moves across ERP, billing, and GTM systems.
Has hands-on experience with financial systems -- ERPs, financial software vendors, or billing and GTM integrations. Familiarity with systems like NetSuite, Aptitude, SOVOS, and Avalara is a strong signal.
Partners across engineering, product, compliance, finance, internal audit, external auditors, and security to build clear, reliable integrations with HubSpot 's financial systems. Can explain a system design to an auditor and a data flow to a controller.
Provides regular and proactive updates so all stakeholders -- engineering and non-engineering -- know where work stands.
Mentors or teaches other engineers on the team or in related areas.
Embraces and effectively leverages AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to enhance productivity and code quality.
When needed, actively participate in the interview process to hire the best people. Embodies HubSpot 's HEART and DI&B values throughout.
RELIABILITY EXPECTATIONS Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems build and maintain systems where an outage or data error has direct financial and legal consequences. Reliability means more than uptime -- it means financial reports are accurate, integrations run correctly, and any failure is documented and corrected completely.
They are a member of the team's PagerDuty rotation. Proficient in operations and incident response, and responsible and responsive to alerts. Can handle minor incidents autonomously but knows when to involve others.
Consistently produces well-tested software that handles failures gracefully and meets code quality guidelines.
Knows all rollout methods (gates, config, canary deploys, library canaries, pre-release tags) and when to use them.
Knows how to debug systems and applications effectively using tools like Metrics, Logfetch, Error Reporting, and Tracing.
Code reviews go deeper than surface-level. Gravitates toward discussions about unhandled edge cases, failure scenarios, performance issues, or regressions -- with particular attention to financial data correctness and edge cases in integration logic.
Raises issues if the team tries to move too fast, cut corners, or reliability starts to drop.
Takes ownership of reliability and security work. Completes work items independently and proactively. Triages work so there is enough time to complete it in SLA.
Owns the reliability of financial reporting and integrations. During month-end and quarter-end close, they are available and responsive. Integration failures that affect financial data are treated as high severity and resolved with urgency.
Incidents in financial systems are documented completely: root cause, impact on financial data, and remediation steps. Finance and Internal Audit are looped in appropriately.
Changes to SOX-controlled systems go through proper change management. Can serve as a qualified second reviewer on any controlled integration check they own.
GROWING IN THIS ROLE There is significant room for growth within the Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems role. Engineers can grow in multiple directions:
Master existing technical skills and expand ownership across more of HubSpot 's financial systems stack.
Go deeper on compliance engineering: SOX controls, audit trail design, change management.
Take on broader system design work and own larger pieces of HubSpot 's financial data layer.
Develop a reputation as a trusted technical resource for Finance leadership and Internal Audit.
Mentor newer members of the Financial Systems team.
Serve as the technical leader for larger financial systems projects, working alongside Finance and engineering leadership to shape multi-year systems strategy.

It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.
We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas.

The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.
XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage.

Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.
At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.

Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure.
Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well.
This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth.

Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production.
Improve developer experience by reducing friction in the build/CI/CD path, strengthen shared libraries.
Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it.
Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software.
Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop.
Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now.
Take part in on-call once up-to-speed, troubleshooting problems that span several technical domains across current and legacy infrastructure.
Essential attributes
Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. Go is what you'd write day to day, but we care more about the fundamentals than the language: strong backgrounds in other statically typed languages are welcome.
Comfortable on Linux, with an understanding of the OS your software runs on (processes, networking basics, packaging, systemd), even if you're not a systems engineer.
Solid grasp of build systems, CI/CD, and release pipelines. You've worked in a monorepo or a serious build/release setup and made it better.
A track record of delivering: shipping, closing out, and not letting scope or polish stall a deliverable.
Good written and verbal communication, and the collaborative instinct to treat non-developer engineers as first-class colleagues.
Desirable attributes
Things we'd like to see. You won't have all of them, and that's fine.
Interest or hands-on experience in developer experience and AI/coding-assistant tooling. Building or integrating LLMs into a real engineering workflow is a plus, but curiosity about how these tools change work practices counts too.
Experience with infrastructure/platform software: inventory/asset systems, monitoring, alerting, scheduling, container orchestration or similar backend platform work.
APIs, data pipelines and schema management: designing clean service APIs and moving data between systems reliably.
Infrastructure-as-code and cloud fluency. We use Terraform and AWS as required, but experience with Azure or GCP is just as relevant.

Who We Are
Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.
We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools.

That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more .
Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.
Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

You'll be tasked with a wide range of projects. Each engineer has a realm they focus on, but we're still small enough that we don't have the luxury of deep specialization. We're looking for technical generalists that aren’t afraid to dive into a new stack or toolchain if the need arises (but JavaScript and Node.js make up the brunt of the existing codebase).
Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (which is an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning from image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment) but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, fighting fires, automating internal processes, and open source projects.
You'll have a wide degree of freedom to advocate for which projects you think should be highest priority and will contribute to our strategy decisions. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role probably won't be a good fit.
The majority of our codebase is written in JavaScript, our machine learning and image processing pipeline is in Python. We run primarily on Firebase and GCS, with some machine learning infrastructure on AWS. We're increasingly using Docker (both internally and for customer facing products like our edge inference server). A lot of our code runs in the browser (including some Tensorflow JS) but we're also working on building APIs and client libraries in several languages.
You certainly don't need to be experienced in all of these areas; but should be excited to learn new skill sets as you need them. We also hope you'll bring some new knowledge and experiences you can share to help level-up the rest of the team.
We’re especially keen to add some rigor to our processes and build the foundation for rapidly scaling the engineering organization (for example: we currently have limited tests and are not using an opinionated front-end framework -- things that will need to change over the coming months in order to be able to seamlessly expand the team).
Example Projects
Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.
Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations image segmentation).
Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.
Streamlining our onboarding flow.
Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.
Next-generation model assisted labeling.
Optimizing speed and scalability.
Who You'll Be Working With
Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.
You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Full Stack Engineers.
Where You'll Work

Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.
